svg.title: Heracles brings the Erymanthian boar to Eurystheus
svg.desc: Line drawing after the 1843 plate of a black-figure amphora (Gerhard, Auserlesene griechische Vasenbilder II, Taf. XCVII, 1): Heracles brings the boar to Eurystheus, who hides in a storage jar, with a nymph and Iolaos at the left and Athena and Hermes at the right; retraced.
